topic: Experiences with social support among older adult women participating in gay square dancing

sources.title: Experiences with social support among older adult women participating in gay square dancing
sources.authors: Beselt LJ, McDonough MH, Walsh CA, Kenny SJ.

findings.finding: Participants felt affirmed and able to be their authentic selves due to the acceptance they experienced.
findings.quote: Findings highlighted that participants experienced acceptance which affirmed their sense of self and enabled their authentic selves.

findings.finding: Specific actions such as demonstrative welcoming helped foster belonging and close relationships.
findings.quote: To foster a sense of belonging and close relationships, specific actions (e.g., demonstrative welcoming of newcomers, mutual support) were taken by other participants in the group.

findings.finding: Physical touch inherent in the dancing was largely perceived as safe and meaningful.
findings.quote: Physical touch is an inherent part of square dancing, which took on different meanings for participants and was overall perceived as safe.

principle: Inclusive group dancing environments provide older adult women with meaningful social support, acceptance, and a strong sense of belonging.
for_the_teacher: Explicitly and demonstratively welcome newcomers to foster a safe and inclusive group environment.
